summary: [Google Analytics 4] polling: Scheduled windowed pulls: runReport with explicit dateRanges (e.g. 7daysAgo to 2daysAgo for stable processed data), limit/offset pagination (this surface does NOT use pageToken; that is the Admin API pattern), returnPropertyQuota=true to read budget. Incremental pattern: watermark = last fully-processed date, not row cursors (rows are computed). Historical data immutable once processed: no tombstones.
